source_key.description: State key to read the content from. Blank = the last message's text (e.g. the HTML an upstream agent/llm node produced). A bytes value is stored verbatim; a dict/list is serialized to JSON.

filename.description: Artifact filename, e.g. 'mockup.html'. The extension drives the default content type. Blank = 'artifact.txt'.

content_type.description: MIME type for the file. Blank = inferred from the filename extension (e.g. .html -> text/html), else text/plain.

unwrap_code_fence.description: If the content is a single fenced code block (```html ... ```), store just the inner code. On by default since models often wrap generated HTML/code in a fence.

preview.description: For HTML artifacts, also render the result live in the console as an interactive, sandboxed inline preview. Off = store the file only, no preview.

$comment: ports: in:[any], out:[any] (writes the default `artifacts` channel)
